scientific_integrity: The proof uses an established graph deformation model and new Burnside and sharp stabilization arguments. Finite enumeration corroborates, not proves, the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Ordered particles only, arm-permutation subgroups, at least three equal arms, at least four particle labels; homotopy equivalence of orbit spaces, not homeomorphism. Prior nonequivariant ranks and two-particle equivariant representations are acknowledged, not claimed new. Residual unindexed-priority risk.
title: Sharp stabilization of symmetry quotients of ordered star-graph configuration spaces
